title: Read byte-column editor text through the underlying widget
answers: Changing mode crashes with an AttrMap get_text error
Cannot edit dns_name_servers in the console
How should the byte-column editor read text from a wrapped widget?
body:
Symptom: Changing string-based console options such as mode or dns_name_servers raises AttributeError: 'AttrMap' object has no attribute 'get_text'.
Root cause: mitmproxy/tools/console/grideditor/col_bytes.py:Edit.get_data called get_text() on the wrapper stored in self._w.
Fix pattern: Read text through self._w.base_widget.get_text()[0], then strip it and convert it with strutils.escaped_str_to_bytes.
Constraints: Applies to text retrieval in the byte-column grid editor; preserve whitespace stripping and escaped-byte conversion. This does not establish a rule for other wrapper operations.
applies: Console option editing that reads values through the byte-column grid editor.
